requirements.display_name: Replacement automotive fuse of the specified amperage

actions.title: Switch the vehicle and electrical switches off
actions.instruction: Switch the vehicle off and turn all electrical switches off before working on the fuse panel.

actions.title: Open the applicable fuse-panel cover
actions.instruction: Open the instrument-panel or engine-compartment fuse-panel cover for the affected circuit.

actions.title: Identify the correct fuse and amperage
actions.instruction: Use the fuse/relay panel label and owner-manual tables to identify the suspected fuse and its specified amperage.

actions.title: Remove and inspect the fuse
actions.instruction: Use the provided fuse puller to remove the suspected blade fuse and inspect whether the element is open.

actions.title: Install a fuse with the same rating
actions.instruction: If the fuse is blown, install a new fuse of the same specified amperage and make sure it fits securely.
actions.warning_text: Never replace a fuse with a higher-rated fuse or substitute wire or foil.

actions.title: Verify the circuit and stop if the fuse opens again
actions.instruction: Restore power as appropriate and verify operation. If the replacement fuse blows again, stop and have the electrical system inspected.
